reviews.text: Jen Taylor is the best hairstylist there ever was! She was so positive, fun, and kind hearted! I would also like to add how fun Abby was! My skin felt like a babies after my treatment! Taylor d Shaw is heaven on earth!!!
I go here for September, she's a fabulous stylist and gets my hair to behave how I want it to. The salon itself is great. Staff is helpful. It's clean and well styled.
I've been coming here for over ten years and I've never been let down. The vibe is always immaculate and I leave feeling refreshed.
